stem: One wall sensor shows normal RH while affected plants cluster inside a dense canopy. Which next step has the highest diagnostic value?
choices: Average the wall reading with yesterday’s room target.
Map temperature/RH at representative canopy positions and compare affected with unaffected locations.
Assume the affected plants have a nutrient disorder because room RH is normal.
rationale: Spatial mapping tests whether the controller reading represents the conditions experienced by affected plants.
